entities.name: Spirokai of the Split Skull
entities.description: A human Akron Legionnaire and Viperdeau Warrior from Kenlefia who led a prisoner escort to Vacar Slab.

entities.name: Kenlefia
entities.description: Land in Jamuraa; its people mete out justice only on Vacar Slab.

entities.name: Vacar Slab
entities.description: A place in the middle of the desert where Kenlefia's people mete justice.

entities.name: Viperdeaus
entities.description: A clan serving the shamans of Kenlefia.

entities.name: The Abuser
entities.description: The prisoner being escorted to Vacar Slab; told Ophelia his name was Markus.

entities.name: Ophelia
entities.description: A member of the escort who freed the Abuser and escaped alone.

entities.name: Teeth
entities.description: The party's water bearer who fell off a cliff, then returned as a zombie and became a mummy.

entities.name: D'Bray
entities.description: The party's flagbearer who died of thirst.

entities.name: Cleatin
entities.description: A Gray Ogre protector killed by a Duneclaw.

entities.name: Methos
entities.description: Party member who died of thirst.

events.summary: Spirokai led a team escorting the Abuser to Vacar Slab, and members began dying on the perilous journey.
events.quote: The journey was perilous, and the party members started dying sequentially.

events.summary: In a sandstorm Ophelia freed the Abuser and tried to escape; Spirokai caught them and buried the Abuser up to the neck.
events.quote: Ophelia freed the Abuser and tried to escape

events.summary: Zombified Teeth slashed Spirokai in the head, then wrapped himself in bandages to become a mummy.
events.quote: he wrapped himself up in the last of their bandages, becoming a mummy

events.summary: Ophelia left Vacar Slab alone while Spirokai began to claw his way out.
events.quote: Spirokai had survived both his head wound and being buried alive, and started to claw his way out.

relations.quote: Spirokai was an Akron Legionnaire and a Viperdeau Warrior.

relations.note: betrayed him by freeing the prisoner
relations.quote: He was about to do the same to Ophelia for betraying him
